They are taking cognac ice cream again!
They definitely want to take all the rings.
I will make one more portion right now.

meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order
the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

+ accusative (where to). Core Russian prep meaning 'in, into' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

видать.gloss: to see (colloq.: не видать = never to see/get)

meanings.en: не видать (+ dative + genitive) — never to see, never to get
meanings.note: colloquial infinitive and past видал

examples.trans: And you'll never see that flat!
He hasn't been seen for a long time.

examples.text: Скажу, что ты нанял людей меня пытать. И не видать вам квартиры!
examples.trans: I'll say that you hired people to torture me. And you'll never see that flat!

meanings.note: In 'до встречи' = until we meet.

examples.text: Решается ваш вопрос, Клавдия Викторовна! Вы не видите, у меня встреча?
examples.trans: Your question is being sorted out, Klavdia Viktorovna! Can't you see I have a meeting?

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'you (polite or plural)' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: + dative of person + accusative of thing
+ infinitive: не даёт мне готовить
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)

meanings.note: Дай! = give (me)!.

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: + genitive.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see
Ещё больше = even more.

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.
Did you see that? She made a gesture!

забрать.gloss: to take back, to take away

meanings.en: to take away, to pick up
meanings.note: забрать детей из школы = to pick the kids up from school
забрать заявление = to withdraw a statement

examples.text: Поговори с Аракеляном. Пусть он заберёт заявление.
examples.trans: Talk to Arakelyan. Get him to withdraw his statement.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, я уже знаю. Мне звонили из мэрии.
examples.trans: Marina Sergeyevna, I already know. The town hall called me.

meanings.note: genitive also 'коньяку' (some cognac)

examples.trans: And you're drinking French cognac yourself.
Katya, do you want some ice cream now?

examples.text: Никак, я уже друзьям обещал, что будет рыбное мороженое.
examples.trans: No way, I already promised my friends there'd be fish ice cream.
That's egg white made from vanilla ice cream.

meanings.note: неверный ответ = wrong answer
неверный муж = unfaithful husband

meanings.en: infidel, unbeliever (as a noun, usually plural неверные)
meanings.note: religious/jocular

examples.trans: Come on, infidels, let's get a move on.

meanings.note: one direction, now; 'Неси!' = Bring (it)!

examples.trans: Yulia, bring a pen and a piece of paper.
Don't laugh. Read me the number.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence
Ну, папа!. Core Russian part meaning 'well; come on' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian pronominal determiner meaning 'one', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Нам очень дорого обходится авторская кухня.
examples.trans: Auteur cuisine costs us very dearly.

examples.text: Это все, кто выходил из отеля.
examples.trans: That is everyone who left the hotel.
What is going on here right now?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'to her', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Она нашла нас на новом месте.
examples.trans: She found us at the new place.
That is it, she got really offended.
She is not answering her phone.

meanings.note: Often with annoyance.

examples.text: Нина, не слушай. Это опять обман.
examples.trans: Nina, don't listen. It's another trick.

examples.text: Он продал этот перстень и уехал за границу.
examples.trans: He sold that ring and moved abroad.
Can you imagine how much such a ring costs?
I wish I had a ring like that!

повторить.gloss: to repeat, to go over again

meanings.en: to repeat, to say or do again
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'вторить').

examples.trans: Right, let's go over it again.
So, repeat that clearly once more.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'казать').

examples.trans: Shall we show this to Anikeev?

examples.text: Ну, покажите руки. Что у вас за спиной?
examples.trans: Well, show me your hands. What is behind your back?

meanings.en: to try, to have a go
meanings.note: + infinitive. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'пробовать').
Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'пробовать').

examples.text: Как я могу это забыть? Ну, давай попробуем.
examples.trans: How can I forget that? Well, let's try.
The waiter brought two portions of salad.

examples.text: И ещё две порции трески с миндалём!
examples.trans: And two more portions of cod with almonds!
Fyodor, prepare two portions of shrimp.

meanings.en: to hurry up, to get a move on
meanings.note: Colloquial, often as a command.

examples.trans: Come on, infidels, let's hurry up.
Hurry up, the guests are already waiting!

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'нести').

examples.text: А я вот вам чаю с сушками принёс.
examples.trans: I've brought you some tea and bread rings.
What did you bring into the flat?

meanings.note: просить прощения = to ask for forgiveness

examples.text: Когда вырасту, ты будешь просить у меня прощения!
examples.trans: When I grow up, you'll be begging me to forgive you!

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'делать').

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

meanings.note: 'сейчас буду' = I'll be right there

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Direction.

examples.trans: The white one? Give me the keys.

meanings.note: там такие деньги = there's so much money in it

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

тащить.gloss: to drag, to pull, to carry, to bring

meanings.note: colloquial: fetch or drag something

examples.trans: Then run, go grab a clothespin quickly!

examples.text: Тащи свою птицу су-шефу на стол!
examples.trans: Drag your bird to the sous-chef's table!

meanings.note: Conversational Russian particle ('like') that adds modal nuance, emphasis, or discourse tone in spoken dialogue.

examples.text: А она типа не при делах.
examples.trans: And she's, like, got nothing to do with it.
This is sort of an omelette.

examples.text: Я точно не помню его адрес.
examples.trans: I don't remember his exact address.

examples.text: Точно, полиция была! А что с машиной?
examples.trans: That's right, the police were there! And what about the car?

meanings.note: + infinitive or a noun.

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: меня = me (genitive/accusative), мне = to me (dative)

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'I' in everyday speech.
